basics.name: Armando Peña Tamayo
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | AI Engineering & SaaS Architecture
basics.summary: Senior full-stack engineer with 8 years of experience taking software from architecture and data modeling through implementation, integration, and deployment. I build AI-powered SaaS and automation systems—multi-tenant platforms, LLM/RAG pipelines, agent orchestration with n8n, and secure APIs—primarily with TypeScript, Node.js, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase. I have delivered remotely with international teams and bring a growing application-security specialization to every engagement.

work.name: CBS Cleaning
work.summary: AI-driven email operations platform for a document-heavy back office. Designed deterministic ETL and normalization ahead of LLM processing, multi-format document extraction (including text from image-based attachments), RAG-style vector retrieval over supporting documents, and tool-enabled n8n AI Agents with Structured Outputs and downstream validation agents. Processed hundreds of emails per day—thousands during rollout—cutting manual processing time by ~70%.

work.name: SuitUp Project
work.summary: Mobile-first body-measurement and virtual try-on MVP for fashion e-commerce. Owned the full-stack build: Next.js architecture, camera-based capture flow, measurement processing, and AR try-on integration. Shipped in four months, reducing time-to-market by ~50% versus typical product timelines.

work.name: AmerAdjust
work.summary: AI document-generation platform for the insurance industry, built from the MVP stage. Designed the multi-tenant foundation from the outset: organization tenant IDs, Supabase Row Level Security, tenant-scoped RBAC, and authorization checks for cross-tenant isolation. Implemented the Next.js/Supabase product and AI document pipeline, reducing document creation time from hours to minutes (~80%).

work.name: Events Management SaaS
work.summary: Serverless microservices for an events-management SaaS on AWS Lambda. Built and maintained backend services and centralized logging/monitoring across functions, reducing incident debugging time by ~40% and improving reliability.

work.name: Explora Jalisco
work.summary: Admin and customer-facing Angular applications integrated with a CMS and backend services. Optimized SEO and frontend performance, improving page load speed by ~30%.

work.name: Wassermeloni
work.summary: Modernized a legacy Angular and Ruby on Rails platform and its delivery workflow. Introduced CI/CD and automated testing to stabilize releases and reduce deployment costs by ~50%.

work.name: Imagined Earth
work.summary: Rebuilt a mobile app with Ionic and Angular, improving client performance and backend/API efficiency. Reduced server costs by ~30% and improved user retention through a faster, more reliable experience.

work.name: Freelance Projects
work.summary: Delivered end-to-end web applications for remote clients across LATAM, including event systems, remittance platforms, and HR tools. Owned requirements, architecture, implementation, authentication, and deployment from concept to production.

projects.name: AI Job Hunter — Personal Agent System
projects.description: Personal agent system that discovers and normalizes job listings, evaluates eligibility with custom tools and deterministic rules (location restrictions, payment compatibility, role classification), and generates tailored CVs and cover letters. Combines multi-stage orchestration, structured LLM output, and rule-based checks over live web data.

projects.name: AI Security Testing Agents — Personal Project
